tagline: SoundCloud is the deck. This is the room.

tracks.title: Collapse (803)
tracks.subtitle: One Step From Collapse
tracks.note: The room after the clock gives out.
tracks.hook: We're one step from collapse — the stereo can't decide which side.
tracks.chords:
Em G D A  (verse)
C G D Em  (chorus)
Let the G ring. Don't quantize the slide.
tracks.production: Fragile psychedelic rock. Tape-warbled slide guitar, droning fuzz bass, loose live drums pushed slightly behind the beat. Analog organ pads, spring reverb, worn-out tape saturation. Abrupt dynamic drops, feedback squeals, unstable stereo imaging.
tracks.lyrics:
[verse]
clock on the wall stuck between ticks
fan cutting circles out of the dusk
tape deck glowing like it knows too much
one step from collapse, don't ask it to hush

[chorus]
we're one step from collapse
the stereo can't decide which side
spring in the tank, slide going wide
leave the room on, let the signal ride

[verse]
radio talking to nobody home
organ pad hanging off a frayed bone
drums late on purpose, bass like a drone
if it holds together that's a loan
